title: 批发销售帐备货主义01
instruction:
您是 Eamon Villanueva，销售经理，负责 Cadwell Fluid Power 与 Pembroke Consortium 的两家俄亥俄州制造工厂的关系。维护主管 Carsten Okonkwo 经营婴儿床31 年，是唯一知道里面到底有什么的人，他于 20 11 月退休。工厂经理 Simone Haldorsen 将在离开前资助一项库存计划，她需要一份可以在 11 月批准的提案，而不是另一份发现报告。准备`pembroke_stocking_program_proposal.pptx`并将其放置在工作目录的顶层。该演示文稿面向 Simone 和运营或交付团队：推荐一种用于软管、配件和过滤的库存和补充配置，包括成本和服务展示，并排除他们可能在页面上询问的替代方案。现实情况是，婴儿床有400平方英尺，D365实例被锁定，工厂2没有条形码接收，企业希望对60停机时间关键的软管组件做出四小时响应，并且彭布罗克的控制器不会携带寄售所有权。卡斯滕已经告诉工厂，每当关键软管出现故障时，卡德韦尔将提供当日更换服务，因此以商业上可信且符合专业服务承诺的方式履行这一承诺。
还要解决从婴儿床中拿走未记录物品或更换类似外观的软管只是为了让绳子移动的诱惑；完成的提案必须明确什么可以要求或不能​​做。使用职业判断来做出合理的计划假设，标记假设和未知数，而不是将虚构的客户事实作为报价来呈现，并使建议可执行而不依赖卡斯滕的记忆。演示文稿不超过10幻灯片，使用可读的决策语言，显示谁拥有材料和操作决策，并以单个批准决策而不是未来工作列表结束。

---

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `pembroke_stocking_program_proposal.pptx` — 为彭布罗克联盟 (Pembroke Consortium) 的两家俄亥俄州工厂提供决策就绪的账户库存计划提案，其中包含综合成本和服务展示。 （恰好一个 PowerPoint 文件。；必须使用准确的文件名保存在工作目录的顶层。；不超过10 幻灯片。；必须包含一项明确的建议、运营模型、成本和服务展示、排除的替代方案、所有权、假设和批准决定。；必须可供工厂运营人员使用，而无需依赖 Carsten Okonkwo 的未记录记忆。）
除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

gold.description: 沿用南杨原题包实际文件与已有公开预览。
gold.note: PPTX 共10页的文字提取；不还原位置、动画和版式。
gold.text:
=== 幻灯片 1 ===
DECISION FOR NOVEMBER APPROVAL
A controlled local micro-crib
with Cadwell hub replenishment
One executable stocking program for hose, fittings, and filtration across Pembroke Consortium’s two Ohio plants.
RECOMMEND
Customer-owned local stock
Critical assemblies + fast movers only
SERVICE BOUNDARY
4-hour response target
For 60 approved critical hose assemblies
TRANSITION
Document before 20 November
Replace Carsten’s memory with a register
Prepared by Eamon Villanueva • Sales Manager, Cadwell Fluid Power
For Simone Haldorsen, Plant Manager, and Pembroke / Cadwell Operations
Planning proposal • assumptions are labeled; no customer transaction history was supplied

=== 幻灯片 2 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Why this configuration
A bounded design resolves every stated constraint; it is not a full assortment or a promise of uninterrupted production.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
02
SPACE
400-square-foot crib
Reserve local capacity for approved critical assemblies, fast-moving fittings, and common filters—not the long tail.
OWNERSHIP
No consignment title
Pembroke takes title to stocked local material at receipt; Cadwell owns remote hub material.
CONTROL
D365 is locked
Use a controlled issue/receipt log and a weekly reconciliation—not an unofficial shadow system.
PLANT 2
No barcode receiving
Use signed receiving slips, bin labels, and reconciliation; manual records are not barcode-equivalent without review.
SUCCESSION + SERVICE
Carsten retires 20 November
Capture his knowledge in an approved specification register before his departure.
CRITICAL REQUIREMENT
60 critical hose assemblies
Cadwell targets a four-hour response after a qualifying call—not a blanket same-day guarantee for all items or failures.

=== 幻灯片 3 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Recommended operating model
One primary configuration: Pembroke-owned local micro-crib + Cadwell-owned remote hub + defined critical-response dispatch.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
03
1  LOCAL MICRO-CRIB • PEMBROKE TITLE
Stock locally
• Approved equivalents / complete coverage plan for 60 critical hose assemblies
• High-frequency fittings and filtration SKUs selected in walkdown
• Labeled bins; min/max cards; controlled issue log
Not locally stocked
Low-use, bespoke and unapproved assemblies—these remain at the hub or are quoted-to-order.
2  CADWELL REMOTE HUB • CADWELL TITLE
Replenish / hold elsewhere
• Demand-driven replenishment to local min/max
• Long-tail fittings, filters and approved hose components held in Cadwell network
• Cadwell validates technical fit before sourcing a non-local critical item
Commercial boundary
Remote hub stock stays Cadwell-owned until a Pembroke purchase order and documented receipt.
3  CRITICAL RESPONSE • QUALIFIED
When a critical hose fails
• Pembroke calls Cadwell duty contact with asset / register ID
• Cadwell acknowledges and mobilizes within the four-hour target under stated conditions
• Local approved stock is issued only against a log entry
Response is not restoration
Availability, technical suitability, installation, system restoration and production restart are distinct outcomes.
Design capacity assumption: fit the approved local set within the 400 sq ft crib after a joint layout check; any excess critical coverage is held at Cadwell’s hub, not improvised in aisles.

=== 幻灯片 4 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Scope is governed by criticality—not appearance or memory
The approved critical-item / specification register becomes the source of truth after Carsten Okonkwo’s departure.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
04
Segment
Decision rule
Local treatment
Identification / control
Owner
Critical
A failure can create defined downtime risk; 60 hose assemblies are in scope after walkdown sign-off.
Local approved assembly or defined hub path; min/max coverage by assembly family.
Asset / register ID, hose ID, size, pressure rating, media / temperature, end fittings, length, application and approved substitute status.
Pembroke Maintenance Engineering
Routine
Repeat-use fittings / filtration with predictable demand or lead-time exposure.
Local bin stock when it fits space and min/max rationale; otherwise hub replenishment.
Manufacturer part number, bin ID, min/max, issue record and receipt reference.
Pembroke Crib Coordinator
Exceptional
Bespoke, low-use, unapproved or technically uncertain item.
Do not locally stock by default; quote / source through Cadwell hub after review.
Technical review ticket and purchase approval; no visual matching.
Cadwell Account / Technical Lead
NON-NEGOTIABLE SAFETY / CONTROL RULE
A similar-looking hose must not be substituted without documented technical suitability confirmation. Holding stock does not prove an assembly is fit for its application; do not remove any crib item unrecorded or consume it informally.

=== 幻灯片 5 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Control workflow that works with locked D365 and Plant 2
The local ledger is a controlled compensating record, reconciled to approved receipts and supplier documents; it does not replace D365 or barcode control.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
05
01  RECEIVE
Cadwell packing slip + Pembroke signed receipt
Bin / lot / quantity logged
›
02  ISSUE
Technician identifies bin / register ID
Log date, asset, quantity, user
›
03  RETURN
Quarantine return; condition review
Log disposition before restock
›
04  RECONCILE
Weekly: Crib Coordinator compares ledger, bins, signed slips and Cadwell invoice / credit
›
05  ESCALATE
Discrepancy, unapproved issue or unknown fit
Hold item; Maintenance Engineering decides
REPLENISHMENT POLICY
Trigger: bin card reaches min / ledger shows below reorder point
Cadwell replenishes routine stock on the next scheduled route; Cadwell delivery lead owns a weekly exception queue. Pembroke Crib Coordinator reviews all critical min/max levels every Friday.
PLANT 2 COMPENSATING CONTROL
No barcode receiving: use a numbered paper receiving slip plus shared controlled ledger
Receiver signs quantity / condition; Crib Coordinator uploads or files slip and reconciles weekly. Manual entry is not equivalent to barcode control without this reconciliation and discrepancy follow-up.
EMERGENCY RESPONSE ≠ DEMAND REPLENISHMENT
Routine replenishment restores planned min/max. An emergency dispatch addresses a qualifying failure and can be constrained by part availability, technical suitability, access and conditions.

Illustrative cost & ownership exhibit

=== 幻灯片 7 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Service exhibit: replace the informal promise with a credible commitment
Cadwell has told the plant it will provide same-day replacement whenever a critical hose fails. This proposal narrows that statement to a defined, auditable service target.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
07
Measure
Bounded commitment
Scope
Only the 60 approved downtime-critical hose assemblies in the signed register at Pembroke’s two Ohio plants. Routine and exceptional items follow scheduled replenishment or quoted sourcing.
Start event
A Cadwell duty contact receives a qualifying failure call during the agreed coverage window with plant, asset / register ID, access information and failure description.
Four-hour endpoint
Cadwell acknowledges, confirms the specification path, and dispatches or stages an approved local / hub assembly path within four hours of the start event.
Coverage conditions
Subject to agreed coverage hours, safe site access, complete identifier, technical validation, transportation conditions and an available approved assembly or components.
Unavailable / unsuitable
Cadwell tells Pembroke promptly, escalates technical sourcing and provides an estimated path. It does not authorize a visual substitute or make unavailable stock appear available.
What is not guaranteed
Response is not fulfillment, installation, pressure testing, system restoration, zero downtime or production restart. A four-hour response target does not guarantee uninterrupted production.
SERVICE EVIDENCE
Monthly review: qualifying calls, response attainment, unavailable / unsuitable events, fulfillment path, stockouts and corrective actions. Same-day language applies only within this defined scope and conditions—not every item, failure mode or circumstance.

=== 幻灯片 8 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Alternatives considered—and ruled out on the same criteria
The recommended hybrid is selected because it meets the combined space, service, control, ownership and transition test.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
08

DECISION LOGIC
The hybrid keeps the scarce crib for controlled, approved risk coverage while title remains clear: Pembroke owns received local inventory; Cadwell owns remote hub material until a documented sale. It is the only option that does not trade away a stated constraint.

=== 幻灯片 9 ===
STOCKING PROGRAM PROPOSAL
Ownership, handover and governance
Make the program repeatable before 20 November; operational assumptions remain visible and change-controlled after launch.
Cadwell Fluid Power  |  Pembroke Consortium • Ohio plants
09
Work / decision
Accountable owner
Cadence / date
Evidence
Critical walkdown + register sign-off
Pembroke Maintenance Engineering (A); Carsten / Cadwell Technical Lead (R)
Complete before 20 November
Approved register; asset/spec fields; substitutions status

Pembroke Maintenance Engineering
Change review before any item is added / altered

Physical crib control + cycle count

Simone Haldorsen + Cadwell Account Manager

UNRESOLVED ASSUMPTIONS TO CONFIRM UNDER APPROVAL
Final SKU/register count, exact crib layout, service coverage window, route timing, pricing and the named receiving / crib roles are planning assumptions—not settled customer facts. These are confirmation gates, not alternate recommendations.

=== 幻灯片 10 ===
SINGLE APPROVAL DECISION • NOVEMBER
Approve the controlled micro-crib program
Authorize Cadwell and Pembroke Operations to implement one customer-owned local stocking program, paired with a Cadwell-owned remote hub.
APPROVAL SCOPE
1. Pembroke takes title to received local inventory under the illustrative $31,500 setup basis; Cadwell retains remote-hub title until documented sale.
2. Cadwell provides the defined four-hour response target for the signed 60-assembly critical register, subject to the stated coverage conditions and exclusions—not a zero-downtime or universal same-day guarantee.
3. The parties complete the walkdown, controlled register, layout and role assignment before Carsten Okonkwo retires on 20 November; final pricing and coverage details are confirmed within this approved configuration.
Approval owner: Simone Haldorsen, Plant Manager
Result: a documented, auditable operation that does not depend on undocumented crib knowledge.
Cadwell Fluid Power • Pembroke Consortium’s two Ohio plants

criteria.description: 提交的交付成果是一个可读的 PowerPoint 演示文稿，具有所需的确切文件名。
criteria.evidence: 文件名和成功打开/渲染。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认该文件存在于工作目录顶层，具有所需的扩展名，并且打开时没有修复提示。

original.criterion: The submitted deliverable is a readable PowerPoint presentation with the exact required filename.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the file exists at the working-directory top level, has the required extension, and opens without repair prompts.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿仅包含 10 幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 直接检查载玻片计数。

original.criterion: The presentation contains no more than 10 slides.
original.grader_hint: Inspect the slide count directly.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿对于工厂经理和运营受众来说是可读且可供决策的。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断文本、表格和图形是否可以按演示大小阅读，以及是否可以在没有口头解释的情况下遵循叙述。

original.criterion: The presentation is readable and decision-ready for a plant manager and Operations audience.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether text, tables, and figures can be read at presentation size and whether the narrative can be followed without oral explanation.

criteria.description: 该提案确定了 Pembroke Consortium、Cadwell Fluid Power、俄亥俄州的两个工厂以及 20 11 月退役截止日期。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找所有命名实体和规定的时间。

original.criterion: The proposal identifies Pembroke Consortium, Cadwell Fluid Power, the two Ohio plants, and the 20 November retirement deadline.
original.grader_hint: Look for all named entities and the stated timing.

criteria.description: 该提案规定了 400 平方英尺婴儿床限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认物理空间限制是明确的。

original.criterion: The proposal states the 400-square-foot crib constraint.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the physical-space limit is explicit.

criteria.description: 该提案指出，D365 锁和工厂2 缺乏条形码接收是操作限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须确认这两个系统条件。

original.criterion: The proposal states the D365 lock and the absence of barcode receiving at Plant 2 as operating constraints.
original.grader_hint: Both system conditions must be acknowledged.

criteria.description: 该提案解决了60停机时间关键的软管组件和要求的四小时响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 人口和响应目标都必须出现。

original.criterion: The proposal addresses the 60 downtime-critical hose assemblies and the requested four-hour response.
original.grader_hint: Both the population and response target must appear.

criteria.description: 该提案承认彭布罗克不会拥有寄售所有权。
criteria.evidence: 商业模式或替代方案幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有权限制必须是明确的，而不仅仅是通过不同的建议来暗示。

original.criterion: The proposal recognizes that Pembroke will not carry consignment title.
original.grader_hint: The ownership restriction must be explicit, not merely implied by a different recommendation.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿提出了一项主要的库存和补充建议。
criteria.evidence: 执行建议和批准幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 首选配置必须是明确无误的；同等推荐选项的菜单不能满足此项目。

original.criterion: The presentation makes exactly one primary stocking-and-replenishment recommendation.
original.grader_hint: A preferred configuration must be unmistakable; a menu of equally recommended options does not satisfy this item.

criteria.description: 推荐的配置可以抵御空间、系统、服务、所有权和继承限制。
criteria.grader_hint: 判断设计是否解决了组合张力，而不是优化一个约束而忽略其他约束。

original.criterion: The recommended configuration is defensible against the space, system, service, ownership, and succession constraints together.
original.grader_hint: Judge whether the design resolves the combined tension rather than optimizing one constraint while ignoring the others.

criteria.description: 推荐的运营模型确定了本地库存的内容、在其他地方补充或保存的内容以及关键组件如何收到所需的响应。
criteria.grader_hint: 这三个要素必须连接成一个连贯的模型。

original.criterion: The recommended operating model identifies what is stocked locally, what is replenished or held elsewhere, and how critical assemblies receive the required response.
original.grader_hint: The three elements must connect into one coherent model.

criteria.description: 该提案为关键、常规和特殊项目定义了可辩护的范围或细分方法。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找明确的类别或决策标准，而不是对项目进行优先排序的通用声明。

original.criterion: The proposal defines a defensible scope or segmentation approach for critical, routine, and exceptional items.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit categories or decision criteria, not a generic statement that items will be prioritized.

criteria.description: 该提案要求通过可用规格或可追溯标识符而不是通过外观或记忆来识别关键软管组件。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受尺寸、压力、端部配件、材料、应用或同等专业标识字段。

original.criterion: The proposal requires critical hose assemblies to be identified by usable specifications or traceable identifiers rather than by appearance or memory.
original.grader_hint: Accept dimensions, pressure, end fittings, material, application, or equivalent professional identification fields.

criteria.description: 该提案为库存物品建立了补货触发器和负责任的审查节奏。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须存在最小/最大、再订购点或同等条件以及节奏和所有者等触发器。

original.criterion: The proposal establishes a replenishment trigger and an accountable review cadence for stocked items.
original.grader_hint: A trigger such as min/max, reorder point, or equivalent plus a cadence and owner must be present.

criteria.description: 补货设计将需求驱动的补货与紧急响应区分开来，并且不将服务承诺视为库存始终可用的证据。
criteria.grader_hint: 这两种机制必须具有不同的目的和局限性。

original.criterion: The replenishment design distinguishes demand-driven replenishment from emergency response and does not treat a service promise as proof that stock will always be available.
original.grader_hint: The two mechanisms must have distinct purposes and limitations.

criteria.description: 该提案指定了 Carsten 离职后项目主控或规范管理的责任。
criteria.grader_hint: 指定的角色或职能（而不仅仅是“团队”）必须拥有该信息。

original.criterion: The proposal assigns responsibility for item master or specification stewardship after Carsten's departure.
original.grader_hint: A named role or function, rather than only 'the team,' must own the information.

criteria.description: 该提案指定了实际婴儿床控制和周期盘点或库存验证活动的责任。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找负责任的客户或供应商角色以及控制活动。

original.criterion: The proposal assigns responsibility for physical crib control and cycle-count or stock verification activity.
original.grader_hint: Look for an accountable customer or supplier role and a control activity.

criteria.description: 该提案提供了一种实用的移交机制，可以在 20 11 月之前捕获 Carsten 的知识。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受结构化的关键项目巡查、批准的登记、签字或等效的知识转移工件。

original.criterion: The proposal provides a practical handover mechanism that captures Carsten's knowledge before 20 November.
original.grader_hint: Accept a structured critical-item walkdown, approved register, sign-off, or equivalent knowledge-transfer artifact.

criteria.description: 该提案包括一种受控接收或发出记录方法，可以在2工厂工作，无需接收条形码。
criteria.grader_hint: 该方法必须指定一个补偿记录或协调控制，而不是简单地重复条形码不可用。

original.criterion: The proposal includes a controlled receiving or issue-record approach that can work at Plant 2 without barcode receiving.
original.grader_hint: The approach must name a compensating record or reconciliation control, not simply repeat that barcodes are unavailable.

criteria.description: 该提案解释了尽管 D365 实例处于锁定状态，但收据、问题、退货和差异如何保持可审计。
criteria.evidence: 控件或工作流程幻灯片。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找受控替代记录以及核对或审查责任。

original.criterion: The proposal explains how receipts, issues, returns, and discrepancies remain auditable despite a locked D365 instance.
original.grader_hint: Look for a controlled alternative record and a reconciliation or review responsibility.

criteria.description: 该提案积极禁止婴儿床库存的未记录清除或非正式消耗。
criteria.grader_hint: 需要明确禁止或同等的积极劝阻；仅仅提及收缩是不够的。

original.criterion: The proposal actively prohibits unrecorded removal or informal consumption of crib stock.
original.grader_hint: A clear prohibition or equivalent active discouragement is required; merely mentioning shrinkage is insufficient.

criteria.description: 该提案指出，未经技术适用性确认，不得更换外观相似的软管。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须将替换与技术确认联系起来，而不仅仅是说“使用正确的部件”。

original.criterion: The proposal states that a similar-looking hose must not be substituted without technical suitability confirmation.
original.grader_hint: The document must connect substitution to technical confirmation, not just say 'use the correct part.'

criteria.description: 该提案指出，四小时响应目标并不能保证零停机或不间断生产。
criteria.grader_hint: 必须说明服务索赔的明确限制。

original.criterion: The proposal states that a four-hour response target does not guarantee zero downtime or uninterrupted production.
original.grader_hint: A clear limitation on the service claim must be stated.

original.criterion: The proposal does not claim that same-day or four-hour service applies to every item, every failure mode, or every circumstance.

original.criterion: The proposal does not claim that holding stock proves an assembly is fit for the application.

criteria.description: 该提案并未声称手动或替代接收记录等同于未经核对的条形码控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 该文件必须承认补偿控制限制。

original.criterion: The proposal does not claim that a manual or alternate receiving record is equivalent to barcode control without reconciliation.

criteria.description: 该演示文稿量化了初始投资或库存风险、经常性运营成本以及与服务相关的成本或资源需求。
criteria.grader_hint: 值可能是场景假设，但所有三个成本类别都必须可见。

original.criterion: The presentation quantifies an initial investment or inventory exposure, recurring operating cost, and service-related cost or resource requirement.
original.grader_hint: Values may be scenario assumptions, but all three cost categories must be visible.

criteria.description: 每个发明的财务数据都被标记为假设、估计、情景或报价要求，而不是作为提供的客户事实呈现。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查标签、注释和来源说明；没有资格的不受支持的精度失败。

original.criterion: Every invented financial figure is labeled as an assumption, estimate, scenario, or quotation requirement rather than presented as a supplied customer fact.
original.grader_hint: Inspect labels, notes, and source statements; unsupported precision without qualification fails.

criteria.description: 成本表使用内部一致的单位、期间和算术，总计与其组成部分一致。

criteria.description: 服务展示定义了四小时测量，包括其开始事件、终点、覆盖条件以及对不可用或技术上不合适部件的处理。

original.criterion: The service exhibit defines the four-hour measure, including its start event, endpoint, coverage conditions, and treatment of unavailable or technically unsuitable parts.
original.grader_hint: A bare 'four-hour SLA' is insufficient; look for operational definitions and boundary conditions.

criteria.description: 服务展览将响应时间与履行、安装、恢复或生产重启时间区分开来。

original.criterion: The service exhibit distinguishes response time from fulfillment, installation, restoration, or production-restart time.
original.grader_hint: Award only if the proposal prevents the reader from interpreting response as guaranteed repair or restart.

criteria.description: 该提案确定了运营部门可用于审查服务绩效和库存状况的证据或指标。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受诸如填充率、响应达到、缺货、紧急事件、库存准确性或与审核相关的老化等衡量标准。

original.criterion: The proposal identifies evidence or metrics that Operations can use to review service performance and stock health.
original.grader_hint: Accept measures such as fill rate, response attainment, stockouts, emergency events, inventory accuracy, or aging when tied to review.

criteria.description: 该提案定义了审查负责人以及针对不断变化的需求、重要性、库存水平或服务假设的审查节奏。
criteria.grader_hint: 所有权和节奏都是必需的。

original.criterion: The proposal defines a review owner and a review cadence for changing demand, criticality, stock levels, or service assumptions.
original.grader_hint: Both ownership and cadence are required.

criteria.description: 该提案排除了所规定的所有权限制的寄售模式，并解释了其运营或财务后果。
criteria.grader_hint: 排除替代方案必须有理由，而不仅仅是列出。

original.criterion: The proposal rules out a consignment model for the stated title constraint and explains its operational or financial consequence.
original.grader_hint: The alternative must be ruled out with a reason, not merely listed.

criteria.description: 该提案排除了完整的本地品种或同等的占用大量空间的选项，因为它与婴儿床限制相冲突或产生了明确的权衡。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找太空拒绝的后果。

original.criterion: The proposal rules out a full local assortment or equivalent space-heavy option because it conflicts with the crib limit or creates an explicit tradeoff.
original.grader_hint: Look for a space-based rejection with consequences.

criteria.description: 该提案排除了仅紧急或纯粹的供应商呼叫模型，因为它无法有力地支持关键响应要求或知识转换。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝必须与四小时目标、退休风险或两者有关。

original.criterion: The proposal rules out an emergency-only or purely vendor-call model because it cannot defensibly support the critical response requirement or knowledge transition.
original.grader_hint: The rejection must connect to the four-hour target, retirement risk, or both.

criteria.description: 将备选方案与用于选择推荐的相同材料标准进行比较。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认空间、服务、系统/控制、所有权和过渡考虑因素没有选择性地应用。

original.criterion: The alternatives are compared against the same material criteria used to select the recommendation.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that space, service, system/control, ownership, and transition considerations are not applied selectively.

criteria.description: 该提案确定了 Cadwell 和 Pembroke 的实施所有权，并使过渡在 20 11 月之前或前后可执行。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找角色级别的所有者以及与退休期限相关的具体时间。

criteria.description: 该提案确定了需要批准或确认的未解决的商业或运营假设，但没有将其作为已确定的事实提出。

criteria.description: 所请求的批准、建议、成本基础、服务承诺和运营所有权在整个演示文稿中都一致。

spec.professional_context: This is a wholesale account-planning deliverable for a fluid-power supplier supporting a manufacturing customer's maintenance operation. The document must be suitable for a plant manager's approval discussion and practical enough for Operations to implement after the incumbent crib expert retires.
difficulty_sources: The practitioner must turn operational constraints into one bounded stocking and replenishment decision without supplied data.
The proposal must quantify costs and service implications using transparent assumptions rather than unsupported commercial facts.
The practitioner must address conflicting inventory ownership, system, space, service-level, and succession constraints.
The proposal must actively discourage an unsafe or uncontrolled common practice and qualify an informal service promise that exceeds defensible professional standards.
The cost exhibit, operating model, recommendation, alternatives, and approval request must agree with one another.

authoring_plan.design_intent: Create a single expert-authored account stocking proposal in doctrinal mode. The reference solution should make one bounded recommendation while pairing every material operating rule with an explicit limitation on what that rule does not authorize or guarantee.

document_constraints.decision_deadline: November, before Carsten Okonkwo retires on 20 November

professional_tensions.required_handling: The chosen design must reserve scarce local space for the items and controls that support the four-hour critical response, while explaining what is not locally stocked and why.

professional_tensions.tension: Locked system and no barcode receiving versus inventory accuracy
professional_tensions.required_handling: The proposal must use a workable compensating record and reconciliation control for Plant 2, not pretend that system limitations do not exist.

professional_tensions.tension: Customer rejection of consignment versus supplier-funded availability
professional_tensions.required_handling: The recommendation must select and explain an ownership/title model compatible with Pembroke's controller and align financial exposure with that model.

professional_tensions.tension: Retiring knowledge holder versus repeatable operation
professional_tensions.required_handling: The plan must convert tacit crib knowledge into a controlled register, specifications, ownership, and review process before the deadline.

professional_tensions.tension: Informal same-day promise versus professional service boundaries
professional_tensions.required_handling: The document must qualify the promise into a defined service commitment and explicitly deny guarantees of universal availability, zero downtime, installation, or production restart.

professional_tensions.tension: Common misuse of uncontrolled stock or visual substitution
professional_tensions.required_handling: The document must actively prohibit unrecorded withdrawals and visually similar substitutions without technical suitability confirmation.

gold_logic.recommendation: Allow the expert author to choose a defensible hybrid or equivalent configuration, provided it is the only preferred recommendation and addresses all five core constraints.
gold_logic.cost_model: Use clearly labeled illustrative assumptions for inventory investment, replenishment, handling, emergency response, and any supplier/customer labor. Show one-time and recurring costs separately and ensure totals reconcile.
gold_logic.service_model: Define the four-hour response start and endpoint, coverage window, geography, critical-item scope, dependencies, and exclusions. Distinguish response from fulfillment, installation, restoration, and restart.
gold_logic.inventory_control: Require traceable item identification, controlled issue and receipt records, discrepancy handling, cycle counting or equivalent verification, and named accountability. The method may be manual or hybrid because D365 is locked and Plant 2 lacks barcode receiving.
gold_logic.ownership_control: State who owns stocked inventory, who bears carrying or obsolescence exposure, and how the arrangement avoids consignment title. The financial exhibit must use the same ownership assumption.
gold_logic.transition_control: Require a structured pre-retirement handover from Carsten's tacit knowledge into a maintained critical-item/specification register and assign post-retirement owners.
alternative_logic: Consignment must be rejected because Pembroke's controller will not carry consignment title.
A full local assortment must be rejected or materially limited because of the 400-square-foot constraint.
Emergency-only/vendor-call coverage must be rejected because it does not credibly support the critical four-hour response and knowledge transition.
gold_logic.governance_logic: Include review cadence, owners, measurable service and inventory-health indicators, and conditions for changing stock levels or service assumptions.
gold_logic.final_decision: End with one approval request for Simone Haldorsen, including the selected configuration, bounded commercial/service assumptions, and the timing needed to implement before the retirement deadline.

quality_review: Render the presentation and inspect legibility.
Recalculate every visible total and verify period/unit labels.
Trace ownership, service promise, assumptions, and recommendation across all slides.
Confirm that no unsupported customer facts are presented as quotations or historical measurements.
Confirm that the two misuse controls and the qualified informal promise are explicit.
Confirm that every doctrinal rule is paired with a limitation or non-claim where applicable.
Confirm the final slide contains one approval decision and not merely next steps.

original_instruction:
You are Eamon Villanueva, the sales manager responsible for Cadwell Fluid Power's relationship with Pembroke Consortium's two Ohio manufacturing plants. Maintenance superintendent Carsten Okonkwo, who has run the crib for 31 years and is the only person who knows what is actually in it, retires on 20 November. Plant manager Simone Haldorsen will fund one stocking program before he leaves, and she needs a proposal she can approve in November rather than another discovery report. Prepare `pembroke_stocking_program_proposal.pptx` and place it at the top level of the working directory. The presentation is for Simone and the Operations or delivery team: recommend one stocking-and-replenishment configuration for hose, fittings, and filtration, include a cost and service exhibit, and rule out the alternatives they are likely to ask about on the page. Work with the realities that the crib has 400 square feet, the D365 instance is locked, Plant 2 has no barcode receiving, the business wants a four-hour response for 60 downtime-critical hose assemblies, and Pembroke's controller will not carry consignment title. Carsten has already told the plant that Cadwell will provide same-day replacement whenever a critical hose fails, so handle that promise in a way that is commercially credible and consistent with professional service commitments. Also address the temptation to take an unrecorded item from the crib or substitute a similar-looking hose simply to get a line moving; the finished proposal must make clear what can and cannot be claimed or done. Use occupational judgment to make reasonable planning assumptions, label assumptions and unknowns rather than presenting invented customer facts as quotations, and make the recommendation executable without relying on Carsten's memory. Keep the presentation to no more than 10 slides, use readable decision-ready language, show who owns the material and the operating decisions, and end with the single approval decision rather than a list of future work.

---

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `pembroke_stocking_program_proposal.pptx` — A decision-ready account stocking-program proposal with an integrated cost and service exhibit for Pembroke Consortium's two Ohio plants. (Exactly one PowerPoint file.; Must be saved in the top level of the working directory using the exact filename.; No more than 10 slides.; Must contain one clear recommendation, an operating model, a cost and service exhibit, ruled-out alternatives, ownership, assumptions, and an approval decision.; Must be usable by Plant Operations without relying on Carsten Okonkwo's undocumented memory.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
